XBRO was super great today!! I tried to speed up the window times as much as possible by tending to bars and delivering those drinks off to the window!! With how busy we were , we started to become a bit behind towards the last couple hours of the shift with all the tasks around the stand , several machines were blinking at once, ices were low and pitchers needed to be filled trash needed to get taken out , everything needed a good restock, because of this I did have to FLEX a lot and couldn’t stay present up in the front of the stand, that’s where I feel if we did have another body on this morning that could’ve primarily focused on floating when needed it would’ve kept our window times more consistent so XBRO Could stay on during those busy rushes!
Overall very proud of the crew for hustling and never giving up today!! Everyone truly worked hard and it was awesome!! So exciting seeing how busy it’s been this last week! Love it for us so much!!!
